I will plant maize with my intercrop and rely mostly on the rains, because here in Manyara that is how I manage this land. I will use some fertilizer, but not too much because cash is limited, and I will also add manure if I can get enough from home. I prefer improved seed for better yield, but I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide or herbicide on this plot.
